To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

image analysis is a powerful tool for phenotyping, that the use of image analysis in phenotyping is still in its infancy and that image analysis is an important tool for phenotyping in the future, especially for high-throughput approaches.
the development of new phenotyping technologies is crucial for the future success of plant science.
image-based phenotyping is a powerful tool to characterize plant traits and plant performance in a high-throughput manner.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of novel, high-throughput, non-invasive phenotyping techniques for plant phenomics, with a focus on root and shoot phenotyping, as well as on the integration of phenotypic data into crop modelling.
the development of image-analysis-based phenotyping approaches that can be used to characterize plant traits in a holistic and high-throughput fashion.
the development, validation, and application of novel phenotyping methods for plant traits that are important for plant breeding and crop production.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the field of image-based plant phenotyping has evolved into a mature and powerful tool to characterize plants in a non-destructive, high-throughput manner.
phenotyping is a very important tool in modern plant breeding.
image-analysis based phenotyping is a powerful tool for plant phenotyping and will be a key component in future breeding strategies for the improvement of crop performance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the phenotyping of plants is a rapidly developing area of research that is increasingly being used for the characterization of plant performance.
phenotyping is a powerful tool for plant breeding.
we are able to characterize the plant performance of a wide range of plant genotypes in a non-destructive way.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the phenotyping of root traits is an integral part of the characterization of plant performance and that the combination of different methodologies is required for a holistic characterization.
phenotyping is a powerful tool for the selection of superior genotypes in breeding and the identification of key genes in genetic research.
the combination of different phenotyping approaches is a powerful tool for plant trait characterization and the identification of plant phenotypes with high performance in the field.
